---
name: Improvement proposal
about: Small, reviewable OSS enhancement or hackathon task
title: "[Improvement] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

**Problem / user story**
Describe the smallest issue using fictional data. Do not include personal details, prompts, customer evidence or secrets.

**Expected output**
Explain observable output and a proposed test.

**Code starting point**
Identify actual module(s) to change (e.g. `forkit/domain/lineage.py`, `forkit/cli/main.py`, `web/src/`).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Positive case works
- [ ] Negative / malformed input handled
- [ ] Existing identity contract and privacy boundaries remain intact
- [ ] Tests, docs and CI pass

**Scope**
State whether this is beginner-sized, or requires a maintainer contract review. No Footprints/Connect integrations or production systems.
